skillCode: var defender = context.rulePiece; if (!defender || !context.piece || context.piece.instanceId !== defender.instanceId) return { success: false, message: '' }; var status = (defender.statusTags || []).find(function(tag) { return tag.type === 'muzan-damage-reduction' && Number(tag.remainingDuration === undefined ? tag.currentDuration : tag.remainingDuration) > 0; }); if (!status || !(context.damage > 0)) return { success: false, message: '' }; context.damage = Math.floor(context.damage * 0.5); return { success: true, message: defender.name + '的无惨之躯使伤害减少50%' };
